heroSummary: Dysart started the 2025–26 school year on Thursday, July 31, 2025, and the last student day was Thursday, May 21, 2026. Fall Break ran October 13–17, Thanksgiving Recess ran November 24–28, Winter Break ran December 22 through January 5, and Spring Break ran March 16–20. Students were dismissed early every Monday beginning August 4 for teacher professional development.
calendarNotes: The official Dysart 2025–26 school calendar lists 180 student days with a 90/90 high school semester split. K–8 quarter counts were 46, 44, 47, and 43 days.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Dysart start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Dysart started the 2025–26 school year on Thursday, July 31, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: Did Dysart dismiss students early every Monday in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The 2025–26 calendar states that students were dismissed early every Monday beginning August 4 for teacher professional development.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Dysart Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Dysart Spring Break ran Monday, March 16, through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Dysart revisions.

customSections.content: The 2025–26 calendar used Monday early dismissal for teacher professional development and separate half-day dates for K–8 conferences, high school finals, and the last student day.
